subject: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@assurely.com>, Ben Cho <ben@bluetrove.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff

Hi Claire, Ben —

Thanks for agreeing to sync. High level goal: get Assurely's GRC connector tied into Redwood's evidence index and land BlueTrove's pen test handoff so that we can surface pen-test artifacts in the Assurely portal for SOC 2 evidence collection.

Ask for this thread:
- Assurely: confirm connector expectations (API endpoints, authentication type, sample payloads) and estimated staging timeline.
- BlueTrove: confirm pen-test scope delivery date and the artifact packaging format you prefer (raw reports + hashes, or zipped reports with JSON manifest).
- Internal: I'll coordinate the test staging account and listing of artifact locations; Monica, can you own the evidence index mapping? Laura, please confirm if we need an SLA addendum for the connector (security review).

Attachments: assurely-connector-specs-v1.pdf (connector fields + example responses)

Proposed milestone: connector deployed to staging + first artifact transfer by 2026-05-21. If that works for everyone, reply with any blocker.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

[attachment: assurely-connector-specs-v1.pdf]

From: Claire Barnes <claire@assurely.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:20:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the summary. We can cover this. Quick points from Assurely:
- We prefer a short-lived API key per customer and an endpoint that accepts multipart/form-data for artifacts plus a JSON metadata payload.
- Staging deployment: we can enable the connector for Redwood staging in 3 business days once we have a test account and API credential.
- We will send a mapping doc (fields we index) by EOD tomorrow — will attach a schema.

Two questions:
1) Do you need us to pull artifacts (Assurely pull) or have Redwood push them to our ingest endpoint? Pulls require a temporary read-only S3 role.
2) Any data residency constraints we should be aware of for the artifacts?

Claire Barnes
Integration Lead, Assurely
claire@assurely.com

Subject: Re: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff

Vivek / Monica —

Thanks for the heads-up. For BlueTrove:
- We will deliver the full pen-test report (PDF) plus an artifacts bundle (zip) containing raw logs and the evidence manifest (JSON). Our preferred handoff is S3 push to a pre-signed bucket you provide; if you prefer an API ingest, we can adapt but will need an endpoint and auth plan.
- Timeline: scoped pentest completes 2026-05-20, deliverables available 2026-05-22.
- We recommend a short embargo (48 hours) between discovery and publication to allow remediation coordination.

Attachment: blueTrove-pen-test-scope-v2.docx (scope and checklist)

Ben Cho
Director, Assessments — BlueTrove Security
ben@bluetrove.com

Subject: Re: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff

Vivek / team —

Sounds good. I can own the evidence index mapping and coordination with Assurely. Next steps from RDW (internal):
- I will produce a mapping CSV that ties our artifact types to Assurely fields by EOD 2026-05-14 (redwood-soc2-artifacts-index.csv).
- Rafael, can you scope the staging S3 role for Assurely pulls and confirm retention policy?
- For the SLA question: Laura, a short addendum stating encryption in transit and at rest plus an incident notification window (4 hours) should be enough. Can you review?

I'll add items to the shared drive and a HubSpot task (HS-Deal-48392). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A7-assurance-sync

Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@assurely.com>, Ben Cho <ben@bluetrove.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff

Team —

Great alignment so far. Consolidated plan below (please confirm):
1) Authentication: Redwood will provision a short-lived API key for Assurely staging (Monica/Rafael to create by 2026-05-15). Assurely to confirm support for API-key ingest.
2) Artifact transfer: BlueTrove will push the artifacts to Redwood staging S3 (pre-signed URL) on 2026-05-22. Alternatively, Assurely can pull if we provide a temporary role — Monica, please confirm preference.
3) Index mapping: Monica will upload redwood-soc2-artifacts-index.csv by 2026-05-14. Assurely will review mapping and return feedback by 2026-05-18.
4) SLA/addendum: Laura to author a short connector addendum (covering encryption, notification SLA) for review by 2026-05-18.
5) Demo: plan a quick staging demo week of 2026-05-25 to validate the end-to-end flow.

Open items:
- Data residency: Vivek/Legal to confirm — initial plan is US-only for these artifacts.
- Embargo window: BlueTrove proposed 48 hours; agree that Assurely should honor embargo before pulling published artifacts.

If no objections, we'll proceed with the timeline. Claire/Ben, please confirm the push/pull preference.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-soc2-artifacts-index.csv]

From: Claire Barnes <claire@assurely.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben@bluetrove.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:28:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Assurance sync: partner connector & pen-test handoff

Vivek / Monica —

Confirmed on Assurely side: we support API-key ingest and will consume a pre-signed S3 push if you prefer that flow. For speed, we recommend BlueTrove push to your pre-signed URL and Assurely perform a follow-up verification pull to index the artifact.

We'll stand up the connector on our staging environment as soon as you provide a test API key and one sample artifact. Please send the staging API key to integrations@assurely.com and we'll run an initial verification by 2026-05-18.

Claire Barnes
Integration Lead, Assurely
claire@assurely.com
